paragraphs: The “Uncategorized” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Uncategorized, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. This is a terminal category in this release, so it provides the most specific available placement along this classification path.

Choose Uncategorized when the product’s primary purpose fits this classification path. Compare its position with adjacent categories under Uncategorized before assigning a product, using the product’s actual function rather than a promotional name. Use this placement for products that fit the named category; products serving a different purpose should be classified in the appropriate neighboring branch.
